name: Claude Pulse
author: iammhador
description: Claude Code in the Omarchy bar: plan limits with pace, every running session with what it is doing now, approvals, model, tokens, cost, subagents and context; a tune when Claude finishes; clickable alerts; a quick prompt launcher with pinned projects; background jobs; 30-day stats; searchable history with one-click resume; and a health check for updates, sign-in and MCP servers.

barWidget.description: Claude plan usage, live Claude Code sessions, stats and history.

schema.label: Colours: claude (Claude's own palette) or theme (your Omarchy theme)
Limit shown on the bar: session or weekly
Show the usage percentage next to the icon
Show how many sessions are waiting for you
Pulse the icon when a session needs you
Colour the icon by usage (green to red)
Hide the icon while no session is running
How often to check sessions, in ms (750-10000)
How often to fetch plan usage, in seconds (300-3600)
Show an alert card when a session finishes or needs you
Seconds a session must wait before the notification
A run this long (seconds) counts as a finished task
Notify at 75% and 90% of a limit, and when it resets
Check status.claude.com for incidents
Show API-equivalent cost estimates
Play sounds (finished tune, needs-you chime, warnings)
Finished tune: claude, claude-marimba or claude-glass (Claude Pulse's own), a freedesktop sound name, a file path, or none
Needs-you sound: claude, claude-marimba, claude-glass, a sound name, a file path, or none
Warning sound: claude, claude-marimba, claude-glass, a sound name, a file path, or none
Sound volume (0-100)
Notify when a session's context is nearly full
Context warning threshold in % (50-99)
Notify when a background job finishes or gets blocked
Editor for 'open in editor': auto (Omarchy default), code, zed or nvim
